claims.text: Both repository Questions name binary-tree Path Sum, but only the ByteDance tagged source preserves a LeetCode 112 mapping; the Tencent source remains variant-unspecified.
For the explicitly mapped ByteDance source, LeetCode 112 requires existence of a root-to-leaf path whose node values sum to targetSum.
The recursive residual-sum DFS and explicit-stack DFS enforce leaf-only success and match a structurally different BFS root-to-leaf sum oracle on 3000 deterministic random trees.
Fixed tests cover empty input, internal-prefix false positives and negative values, while a 5000-node deep chain verifies the iterative path without relying on JVM recursion depth.

checks: 3000 fixed-seed trees against independent BFS path-sum oracle

boundary_tests.expected: false because no root-to-leaf path exists

boundary_tests.case: internal prefix equals target but node is not a leaf

boundary_tests.expected: matching negative sum accepted without monotonic pruning
recursive and iterative match independent BFS root-to-leaf sum enumeration
iterative implementation succeeds without JVM recursion dependence

findings: The current repository has two Path Sum Questions under one surviving Canonical: a generic Tencent wording with no preserved variant and a ByteDance wording whose tagged record explicitly maps to LeetCode 112.

The revised candidate no longer presents the LeetCode 112 mapping as a fact about the generic Tencent source; it explicitly separates the unrecovered generic variant from the mapped source contract before presenting executable 112 logic.

The executable Java implementation remains leaf-only root-to-leaf existence logic and the structurally different BFS root-to-leaf-sum oracle still matches both recursive and iterative implementations on 3000 deterministic random trees.
Fixed tests retain the internal-prefix false-positive trap, empty-tree behavior and negative values; the iterative form still passes the 5000-node deep-chain boundary.
The alias consolidation therefore improves source reachability without broadening the generic source into an invented Path Sum variant.
No new fabricated project experience, unsupported source attribution, placeholder implementation or coding hard failure is introduced by the source expansion.
Formal promotion remains governed by repository promotion, required human approval and real-review policy.
